description: An API that accepts bearer tokens and validates them on each request instead of keeping a login session.
A Spring Security configuration that creates no HTTP session, so every request must carry its own credential.
The signed fields of a token, such as subject, expiry and the roles claim that the API maps to authorities.
A rule set that ends with anyRequest().denyAll(), so a route is open only when a rule says so.
A defense against forged browser requests that rely on cookies, which is not needed when a script attaches the bearer token itself.
A MockMvc helper that fabricates an authenticated JWT principal with chosen authorities, so tests need no real token.
